title: MAP LABEL BOXES FOLLOW HIS WORDING
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-08, in v19.02: the map label placer measured each label on its original words, but the words drawn are his edits, so a longer wording could overlap a neighbour the placer thought was clear, and a label he blanked still pushed other labels aside for a word never shown. The box is measured on the words drawn now, and a blanked label takes no room.
now: Map labels make room for your own wording.
